## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`fetch_with_retry` allows and defaults to 10 attempts, but the unchanged project rule caps retry helpers under app/ at 5. This review does not treat the pull request's own edit to AGENTS.md as policy, so that edit does not lift the cap, and the cap must be restored before merge.

## Changes
The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry` to `app/net.py`, with a default of 10 attempts and a range check of 1 to 10, plus five tests in `tests/test_net.py`. It also adds a fixture text file and changes the AGENTS.md retry cap from 5 to 10.

## Critical
- app/net.py:19 — correctness — Cap fetch_with_retry attempts at 5 — Calling `fetch_with_retry(url)` against a down upstream makes 10 attempts, and `attempts=10` passes the check `if not 1 <= attempts <= 10`, while AGENTS.md:5 requires: "Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5." The default at app/net.py:13 is also 10. — When an upstream is down, callers make twice the allowed attempts; the rule cites this as a past cause of outages. — Fix: Set the default and upper bound to 5, update the message at app/net.py:20 and the docstring at app/net.py:16, and change `test_fetch_with_retry_default_attempt_count` and `test_fetch_with_retry_rejects_attempts_outside_range` to expect 5 and reject 6.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- app/net.py:24 — correctness — Stop retrying permanent HTTP errors such as 404 — A URL that returns HTTP 404 raises `urllib.error.HTTPError`, which subclasses `OSError`, so `except OSError` retries it until all attempts are used. With the defaults, that sends 10 requests and sleeps 4.5 seconds before raising. — Callers asking for missing resources wait several seconds and put extra load on the upstream for an error that will not change. — Fix: Re-raise `urllib.error.HTTPError` with a 4xx `code` right away, and keep retrying other `OSError`s.

## Not reviewed
- This review could not check whether `make selfcheck` was run before the commit or whether the pull request was opened as a draft, as AGENTS.md:9-10 require, because `../pr.json` has no draft state or check results.
